name: flycal-cli
title: flycal CLI MCP tools catalog
description: Machine-readable catalog of flycal-cli commands for MCP servers. Each tool maps to a CLI invocation. Non-interactive tools are safe to run from an MCP host; interactive tools require a TTY.

locale.description: Override UI locale for this invocation only. Falls back to config locale, then en.

notes: locale it also accepts DD-MM-YYYY / DD/MM/YYYY
locale en also accepts MM-DD-YYYY / MM/DD/YYYY
optional time: THH:MM or space + HH:MM(:SS)
bare weekday = next occurrence including today if it matches

config.credentials_note: Default/test phase: project-provided API credentials — just run flycal login. Creating your own Google Cloud Console OAuth client is optional and only needed if you want to use your own API project; save that JSON as ~/.flycal/credentials.json then run flycal login.

calendar_default.description: Default Google Calendar ID. YAML null (~) means unset.

slots.templates.description: Named day/hour schedules for flycal slots. Default used = first key (usually work).

slots.defaults.from.description: Default value for slots --from when omitted

slots.defaults.default_duration.description: Default value for slots --duration when omitted

slots.free_before.description: Busy buffer before each slot start

slots.free_after.description: Busy buffer after each slot; free gaps must fit duration + free_after

slots.exclude_calendars.description: Calendar IDs whose events block free slots. If empty, calendar_default is used.

notes: flycal is read-only against Google Calendar (no create/update/delete of events).
Auth uses OAuth desktop flow; tokens live under ~/.flycal/.
Prefer quoting values with spaces (e.g. --in "3 days", --from "next monday").
slots copies the availability list (without header) to clipboard when pbcopy, wl-copy, xclip, or clip is available.

tools.name: flycal_version
tools.title: Show flycal version
tools.description: Print the installed flycal-cli version string (e.g. flycal 0.7.3).

tools.name: flycal_update
tools.title: Update flycal gem
tools.description: Run `gem update flycal-cli` to install the latest published version.

tools.name: flycal_login
tools.title: Connect Google account
tools.description: Start OAuth browser login. Requires ~/.flycal/credentials.json and a browser/TTY. Interactive.

tools.name: flycal_logout
tools.title: Disconnect Google account
tools.description: Remove stored Google OAuth tokens and disconnect the account.

tools.name: flycal_calendars
tools.title: List calendars
tools.description: List available Google calendars as lines of "name id". Read-only; does not change config.

tools.name: flycal_config
tools.title: Configure flycal (interactive)
tools.description: Interactive configuration menu. Prefer editing ~/.flycal/config.yml from MCP hosts unless a TTY is available.

menu_options.description: Single-select default calendar; saved as calendar_default
Multi-select calendars whose events block slots; saved as slots.exclude_calendars (min 1)

tools.name: flycal_search
tools.title: Search calendar events
tools.description: Search Google Calendar events. Prints one line per event (Calendar | Start | End | Title) plus a summary with total occupied time (hours/minutes and 8-hour working days). Ranges >7 days add weekly breakdown; >30 days monthly. Read-only.

calendar.description: Calendar name or ID to search.

from.description: Range start. Absolute or relative date/time.

to.description: Range end. Ignored when `in` is set.

description.description: Case-insensitive contains filter on event summary or description.

format.description: Output format. Currently only text; json planned.

calendar.description: --calendar / -c. Calendar name or ID. Default: calendar_default from config.

from.description: --from / -f. Start datetime. Default: today midnight. Absolute (YYYY-MM-DD, locale dates) or relative (monday, tomorrow, next monday, lunedi, …).

to.description: --to / -t. End datetime. Default: 23:59 of day 30 from today. Ignored when `in` is set. Same formats as from.

description.description: --description / -d. Case-insensitive contains filter on event summary or description.

format.description: --format. Output format (default: text). json coming soon.

tools.name: flycal_slots
tools.title: Find free time slots
tools.description: Find continuous free ranges using a slots.templates schedule (days + hours). Default template = first key (usually work). Busy events come from slots.exclude_calendars (or calendar_default if empty). Respects free_before/free_after. Prints header + availability; copies availability list to clipboard when a clipboard tool exists.

duration.description: Minimum free-range length to keep a slot.

from.description: Search window start. Absolute or relative date/time. If date-only is today, starts from now.

template.description: Named schedule from config slots.templates (e.g. work, dinner).

calendar.description: Fallback calendar name/ID only when slots.exclude_calendars is empty/unset.

includes: link: Google Calendar day URL at --from
availability ranges grouped by day (copied to clipboard without header)
output.example:
found 6 slots
from sat 1 August 2026 to sat 8 August 2026
with duration 45min, template dinner
considering calendars
- Work
- Personal
link: https://calendar.google.com/calendar/r/day/2026/8/1

saturday 1/8
19 - 23

duration.description: --duration. Slot length. Optional. Default: slots.defaults.default_duration (45min). Examples: 45min, 1h, 90min.

from.description: --from / -f. Window start. Optional. Default: slots.defaults.from (now). Absolute dates (YYYY-MM-DD, locale dates) or relative (now, today/oggi, tomorrow/domani, monday/lunedi, next monday/prossimo lunedi, last friday/scorso venerdi).

in.description: --in / -i. Window length from --from. Optional. Default: 1 week. Examples: "5 days", 1week, "12 days", 48hours.

template.description: --template / -T. Template name from slots.templates. Optional. Default: first template (usually work). Built-ins: work (Mon-Fri office hours), dinner (evening hours).

calendar.description: --calendar / -c. Fallback calendar name/ID when slots.exclude_calendars is empty.

mcp_implementation_hints.execution: Spawn the flycal binary with argv from command.argv, or build argv from argv_template + option_map for each provided parameter. Capture stdout/stderr and exit code. Return stdout as MCP text content.
mcp_implementation_hints.parameter_building: For each non-null input property present in option_map, append the mapped flag and value. Quote values with spaces. Always append --locale when locale is set.
mcp_implementation_hints.interactive_tools: Do not auto-run tools with interactive=true unless the host provides a TTY. Tell the user to run them in a terminal.
mcp_implementation_hints.auth_errors: If output indicates the user is not connected, suggest flycal login (after credentials.json is in place).
mcp_implementation_hints.tool_filter: Prefer exposing flycal_search, flycal_slots, flycal_calendars, and flycal_version to agents.
